December Newsletter

Happy Holidays from the ArcheAge Classic team! :christmas_tree:

Hello everyone! The ArcheAge Classic team wishes everyone a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!

We wish for the coming year to be full of happiness for all of our players and we hope you'll keep supporting us as we move forward into a new year!

Early 2025 Sneak Peek

We wanted to reveal a few things that we have in the pipeline for 2025 to give everyone some neat things to look forward to. In no specific order, here are some of the things planned for the start of the new year:

New Website and Launcher

As a continuation of our efforts to help make joining the game as easy as possible, we'll be publishing a new launcher soon that has both a redesign and improved functionality! This includes the ability to install directly from the launcher, repair your game, support for other languages (note that any custom content will be published in English by default until we can find translators) and hopefully a smoother experience for anyone joining Classic.

Alongside that new launcher, we'll also be moving towards a new website: It'll contain more information about the game, look nicer, perform better and overall feel much better to use daily.

More Dawnsdrop Tools

We’re continuing to expand the Dawnsdrop Tools system in 2025! Starting in January, we’ll release at least two new tools per month, beginning with the Dawnsdrop Pitchfork and the Dawnsdrop Merchant’s Costume. You can look forward to more tools later on, with existing tools gaining new grades too as we progress. We hope this helps players feel a sense of progression on their vocational activities.

New Custom Activities & Events

We’ve teased it before, and it’s finally happening—new world events are on the horizon! Here’s what you can expect:

  • Community Goals: These cooperative challenges will require the entire server to work together to unlock exciting rewards, the first of which being the Rocket Glider.
  • PvE-PvP Hybrid Events: These events will create opportunities for players to face PvE challenges while battling rival factions for dominance. The sky will fall
  • Mystery Update: Something special is coming that will test your teamwork, strategy, and determination. We’re keeping the details under wraps for now, but trust us—it’s going to be worth the wait!

Christmas Gift :gift:

Every player will find a small christmas gift on their account today! Log onto the website, go on the Services tab and claim it to the character of your choice

Thank You for an Incredible Year!

As 2024 draws to a close, we want to thank each and every one of you for being part of the ArcheAge Classic community. Whether you’re a longtime player or just joined this year, your passion and dedication inspire us to keep delivering the best experience possible.

Here’s to an amazing 2025 filled with adventure, camaraderie, and unforgettable moments. See you in the game!

Happy Holidays, The ArcheAge Classic Team

== December Newsletter ==

== Happy Holidays from the ArcheAge Classic team! :christmas_tree: ==
Hello everyone! The ArcheAge Classic team wishes everyone a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!

We wish for the coming year to be full of happiness for all of our players and we hope you'll keep supporting us as we move forward into a new year!

== Early 2025 Sneak Peek ==

We wanted to reveal a few things that we have in the pipeline for 2025 to give everyone some neat things to look forward to. In no specific order, here are some of the things planned for the start of the new year:

=== New Website and Launcher ===
As a continuation of our efforts to help make joining the game as easy as possible, we'll be publishing a new launcher soon that has both a redesign and improved functionality! This includes the ability to install directly from the launcher, repair your game, support for other languages (note that any custom content will be published in English by default until we can find translators) and hopefully a smoother experience for anyone joining Classic.

Alongside that new launcher, we'll also be moving towards a new website: It'll contain more information about the game, look nicer, perform better and overall feel much better to use daily.

=== More Dawnsdrop Tools ===
We’re continuing to expand the Dawnsdrop Tools system in 2025! Starting in January, we’ll release at least two new tools per month, beginning with the Dawnsdrop Pitchfork and the Dawnsdrop Merchant’s Costume.
You can look forward to more tools later on, with existing tools gaining new grades too as we progress. We hope this helps players feel a sense of progression on their vocational activities.

=== New Custom Activities & Events ===
We’ve teased it before, and it’s finally happening—new world events are on the horizon! Here’s what you can expect:

* Community Goals: These cooperative challenges will require the entire server to work together to unlock exciting rewards, the first of which being the '''Rocket Glider'''.
* PvE-PvP Hybrid Events: These events will create opportunities for players to face PvE challenges while battling rival factions for dominance. ''The sky will fall''
* Mystery Update: Something special is coming that will test your teamwork, strategy, and determination. We’re keeping the details under wraps for now, but trust us—it’s going to be worth the wait!

== Christmas Gift :gift: ==
Every player will find a small christmas gift on their account today! Log onto the website, go on the Services tab and claim it to the character of your choice

== Thank You for an Incredible Year! ==
As 2024 draws to a close, we want to thank each and every one of you for being part of the ArcheAge Classic community. Whether you’re a longtime player or just joined this year, your passion and dedication inspire us to keep delivering the best experience possible.

Here’s to an amazing 2025 filled with adventure, camaraderie, and unforgettable moments. See you in the game!

Happy Holidays,
The ArcheAge Classic Team
